title: celastrus lanceolatus
intro: Celastrus lanceolatus, commonly known as staff tree or staffvine, is a plant species belonging to the family Celastraceae. It is a deciduous woody vine native to the mountainous regions of northern China and the Himalayas. The staff tree is valued for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immune-boosting properties. The bioactive constituents of Celastrus lanceolatus include alkaloids, flavonoids, and lignans, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral effects.
